title: Inkling 2 Mini: open-weight small model uses looped transformer
summary: Thinking Machines has released Inkling 2 Mini, an open-weight small model that uses a looped transformer architecture. The release is positioned for local use, with commenters reporting it runs through llama.cpp: one measured about 27 tokens/s decoding on a Ryzen 395 with Vulkan, and another about 10 tokens/s on a 32GB M1 Pro using q4 xl quantization. Benchmark claims circulating with the release put it near a model referred to as Qwen3.8-27B, but those results have not been independently verified in the supplied material. Local users also note unmerged llama.cpp pull requests and a small patch that one report says gives roughly a 30% speed boost.
